rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for stating something clearly or spelling out a condition.

example.english: You need to specify the deadline first.
example.traditional: 你要先講明個截止日期喎。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 sin1 gong2 ming4 go3 zit6 zi2 jat6 kei4 wo3

rows.note: Use this when the speaker emphasizes identifying or stating one precise point rather than explaining it at length.

example.english: Please specify one of the key points to be discussed at this meeting.
example.traditional: 請你指明今次會議要討論嘅其中一個重點。
example.jyutping: ceng2 nei5 zi2 ming4 gam1 ci3 wui6 ji5 jiu3 tou2 leon6 ge3 kei4 zung1 jat1 go3 zung6 dim2

rows.note: Use this mainly when listing detailed requirements, terms, or conditions in writing.

example.english: The contract will specify all the payment terms.
example.traditional: 合約會列明所有付款條件。
example.jyutping: hap6 joek3 wui6 lit6 ming4 so2 jau5 fu6 fun2 tiu4 gin6
